All seeds present specific multi-digit numbers (e.g., 4560, 2897, 7312, 5002) as the operands to be compared.
The seeds involve comparing numbers in the thousands range (e.g., 4560 vs 1188 in seed 11, 7312 in seed 57, 6745 in seed 23), which appropriately targets the 'up to 10 000' constraint.

All seeds utilize the mathematical comparison symbols =, >, and < in either the question text, the multiple-choice options, or as the true/false statement to evaluate (e.g., '2897 < 6745' in seed 23).
